description: Minimum distance between two solid bodies in the same Part Studio, each named by part id or by the feature that created it. 0 (clear: false) means they touch or overlap, so this is also the interference check — e.g. a bracket against a dummy servo body. Returns inches and millimetres, plus the closest point on each body.

a.description: The first body: give exactly one of part or feature.

feature.description: Id of the feature that created the body, e.g. an extrude with op NEW.

b.description: The second body: give exactly one of part or feature.

feature.description: Id of the feature that created the body, e.g. an extrude with op NEW.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_clearance
title: Measure clearance between two bodies
